page.layout: One page of verse, centred in the main block; a marginal note at the right margin beside the verse ("Secretarius interpres Argentinensis, &c."). Below the verse a signature "B 3" at the foot. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.p:
Labe qui procul atque falsitate,
Tum Deo cupis ipse perprobari:
Tum cupisque alios probari: LEGVM
Zelo praeditus & bono, atq; magno,
Verè Davidicóque, REGIOQUE.
main_text.head: FRANCISCVS DE VEIRAS:

p.i: Hac qui praeditus est Fide; periclì
Tutus degit is omnis, haut movetur,
Haut nutat, trepido haut metu pavescit,
Sit Christus tuus ut Redemtor unus;
FIDE nixus agus: tuos in hostes
Tu meum auxilium optimum in periclo es:

page.notes: Marginal note at right is printed beside the verse; text partly faint due to show-through from the reverse. Some words in the verse are uncertain (e.g. "Vt", "agus", "unus") and reproduced as printed.
